**Summary (EVAL-06 — Push notifications with order details):** 5 threats. The headline risk is that full order contents and the delivery address appear on the lock screen by default, readable by anyone holding the phone. Also flagged: personal data handed in clear text to the third-party push provider, notifications continuing after logout or device handover, an unauthenticated notification send path usable for brand-impersonating phishing, and no verification that the target device belongs to the order's owner. Verdicts and requirement statuses are unchanged — only people can set those in the Threatline panel.
